errors.text_span: with tick marks at every integer interval
errors.evidence: The tick marks on the x-axis are not at every integer interval; they are at intervals of 2 (1, 3, 5, etc.).

errors.text_span: and then remains nearly constant at 1.0 from s_pop frequency 11 to 19
errors.evidence: The description for the blue line incorrectly states it remains nearly constant at 1.0 from x=11 to x=19. The plot shows a noticeable dip in accuracy to approximately 0.9 at s_pop frequency 13.

errors.text_span: then declines to approximately 0.48 at s_pop frequency 13
errors.evidence: The description of the green line is incorrect. At s_pop frequency 13, the accuracy is approximately 0.6, not 0.48. The line actually declines to ~0.46 at frequency 9, rises to ~0.66 at frequency 11, and declines again to ~0.5 at frequency 15. The description completely misrepresents the trend of the green line.

errors.text_span: subsequently rises again to approximately 0.99 at s_pop frequency 17
errors.evidence: The green line rises to exactly 1.0 at s_pop frequency 17, not approximately 0.99.
The description of the y-axis omits the tick interval, which is 0.2.
